items.text: Buffalo (Thu practice report; Wed was a walkthrough, so those designations are estimates): DNP - RT Spencer Brown (ankle, downgraded from Limited Wed). Limited - LT Dion Dawkins (rib) and LG Alec Anderson (ankle), both missed Wk9; C Connor McGovern (neck); CB Christian Benford (wrist); TE Dalton Kincaid (ankle); DB Sam Franklin (shoulder, added Thu). Full - DT Greg Gaines (calf), DE T.J. Sanders, G Ar'maj Reed-Adams. Four OL starters on the report. IR - WR Joshua Palmer (hamstring). No game designations yet. Josh Allen starts.

items.text: NY Jets (Thu practice report): DNP - DT Harrison Phillips (ankle) and LB Trevin Wallace (groin), both DNP Wed and Thu; CB Jarvis Brownlee Jr. (illness, added Thu). Limited - WR Garrett Wilson (concussion, missed Wk9; limited Wed and Thu), WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle), DE Joseph Ossai (ankle), CB Nahshon Wright (back). Full - S VJ Payne (knee, returning from IR). IR - DT T'Vondre Sweat, DT David Onyemata, T Max Mitchell. No game designations yet. Geno Smith starts.
